system.description:
• Unbroken: Once per encounter, when reduced to 0 HP or below, immediately stand at 1 HP.
  • No save, no check — pure will
  • For the next round you are immune to all damage
  • All your attacks during that round deal +2 damage dice
  • After that round normal rules resume

activities.name: Unbroken
activities.text: When reduced to 0 HP or below, stand at 1 HP, immune to all damage for the next round, with +2 damage dice on your attacks.
